title: Looking upwards, along the Grand Gallery, inside the Great Pyramid 1984 (50535456558).jpg
author: Mike McBey
credit: Looking upwards, along the Grand Gallery, inside the Great Pyramid 1984
description: This is deep inside the gigantic Egyptian Pyramid of Khufu, otherwise known as the Great Pyramid, which dates from 2550 BC. I have two pictures of the Grand Gallery, which leads upwards to the King's burial chamber. The Gallery is a large void inside the pyramid.
